abstract: The ultrastructure of the yolk sac of a 39 day old human embryo was studied. The subcellular organization was suggestive of a highly specialized absorptive function proceeding in an exocelomic-viteline direction. These findings, compatible with intense metabolic activity, are at variance with the concept of rapid involution of the yolk sac following completion of its hemopoietic and angiogenetic functions. The speculation is advanced that a potential avenue exists in the yolk sac whereby maternally derived products encounter fetal endoderm. Ultrastructural features in the normal yolk sac were compared to those existing in a tumor showing the "endodermal sinus" pattern, and reviewed in the light of the pertinent literature. These findings support the concept that attributes an endomesoblastic derivation to such neoplasms.
abstract_ja: 39日齢のヒト胚の卵黄嚢の超微細構造を調べた。その所見は、高度に特化した吸収機能を示唆しており、「造血機能と血管新生機能の完了後に卵黄嚢は急速に退縮する」という従来の考え方とは異なる。卵黄嚢の正常所見を、「内胚葉洞」パターンを示す腫瘍の所見と比較し、関連する文献とともに検討した。母体由来の物質が胎児の内胚葉に到達しうる経路が存在する可能性が示唆される。これらの所見は、この種の腫瘍が内中胚葉性の由来であるとする考えを支持する。
